acceptance_rule: Both batches must pass superiority against both SFT controls, every domain/math noninferiority gate and every absolute quality gate. No individual comparison win can establish acceptance.
within_attempt_multiplicity: Intersection-union claim: acceptance requires every component. No choice among controls, batches or endpoints after evaluation.
candidate_selection: Regrade all three weights and both controls at all four seeds under anchor-weight-development-v2; freeze the selected candidate before selecting new confirmation inputs.
sample_size_rule: Choose and record counts using observed DEV uncertainty and the audited unused pool before any fresh predictions. Never resize or redraw using confirmation labels or predictions.
coverage_boundary: Alpha spending is prospective nominal accounting. Percentile bootstrap intervals have asymptotic coverage, not a finite-sample family error guarantee. Query inference conditions on the four observed training seeds.
historical_boundary: Earlier observed confirmations were exploratory and failed; this prospective family does not retroactively correct their multiplicity.
population_boundary: ESCI full official test queries and GSM8K official train questions unused in recorded project inputs; public benchmark pretraining exposure remains unknown.
